slvDev/esp32-ai.one_liner: ESP32 端侧 AI 项目

intro.one_liner: 微控制器端侧模型实验
intro.what_it_is: 这是一个让语言模型和果蝇连接组演示运行在 ESP32-S3 微控制器上的项目，模型与计算都留在设备端。
intro.problem_solved: 它尝试解决微控制器内存过小、难以容纳较大模型的问题：把大量参数放在闪存中，按需读取少量数据。
intro.who_should_care: 关注嵌入式设备、端侧推理和小型模型部署的开发者。
use_cases: 在 ESP32-S3 上生成短故事
演示设备端问答模型
运行果蝇避蛛连接组演示
intro.hype_or_trend: 短期热点，一周涨了 1,310 星且曾上日榜。
intro.risk_notes: 模型能力有限，不会回答问题、遵循指令、写代码或掌握事实；果蝇演示只移植部分神经系统；未关闭问题 23 个。
evidence: This is a 28.9 million parameter language model that generates text on an ESP32-S3 microcontroller. It runs on the chip itself, with nothing sent to a server
The model was trained on TinyStories, so it writes short, simple stories and mostly keeps them coherent. It will not answer questions, follow instructions, write code, or know facts.
It is only part of the brain because the whole nervous system does not fit

Synchronous single document conversion

evidence: Dotted thought-orb loading indicators for AI & agent UIs. Nine hand-tuned animated states, each shipped at two purpose-tuned sizes, rendered on a plain 2D canvas

PentesterFlow/agent.one_liner: 终端里的攻击安全智能体

intro.one_liner: 终端内的渗透测试 AI 代理
intro.what_it_is: PentesterFlow 是一个开源的终端 AI 助手，面向获得授权的攻击性安全测试工作；它连接本地或托管的 LLM，在已设定范围的目标上规划测试步骤，调用真实的渗透测试工具，并在执行敏感操作前请求人工批准。
intro.problem_solved: 针对通用 AI 代理在安全场景中容易产生幻觉式漏洞结论、上下文保持能力弱、工具集成差、审计性不足的问题，它通过内置渗透技能、证据确认机制、会话记忆与可复现命令来弥补。
intro.who_should_care: 渗透测试工程师、漏洞赏金猎人，以及需要可审计 AI 辅助的安全团队。
use_cases: 对授权目标进行侦察、枚举与 Web 漏洞验证（如 IDOR、SSRF、SSTI、JWT、GraphQL）
在长周期评估中保存会话与本地知识库，恢复上下文继续测试
将 Burp 抓包流量导入代理，进行查询与证据收集，并输出 Markdown 漏洞报告
intro.hype_or_trend: 短期热点：AI Agent 与安全自动化结合是当前关注方向，但项目仍处于 v0.3.0 早期版本。
intro.risk_notes: 仅限获得明确授权的系统使用；代理可执行 shell 命令、发起 HTTP 请求、编辑文件并处理抓包流量；README 提示存在 yolo 权限模式，需谨慎配置。
evidence: PentesterFlow is an open-source terminal assistant designed specifically for authorized offensive-security work.
Use PentesterFlow only on systems where you have explicit authorization. The agent can run shell commands, make HTTP requests, edit files, and process captured traffic after approval.
`confirm_finding` should be used only after reproduction with request/response evidence.

evidence: High performance observable collections and synchronized views, for WPF, Blazor, Unity.

ObservableCollections is a high performance observable collections(`ObservableList<T>`, `ObservableDictionary<TKey, TValue>`, `ObservableHashSet<T>`, `ObservableQueue<T>`, `ObservableStack<T>`, `ObservableRingBuffer<T>`, `ObservableFixedSizeRingBuffer<T>`) with synchronized views and Observe Extension for [R3](https://github.com/Cysharp/R3).

Observable Collections themselves do not implement `INotifyCollectionChanged`, so they cannot be bound on XAML platforms and the like. However, they can be converted to collections that implement `INotifyCollectionChanged` using `ToNotifyCollectionChanged()`, making them suitable for binding.
